projectId.description: Optional fourth segment (version or project variant)

notes.segments: Must contain 3 segments (prefaceId-clientId-appId) or 4 segments (add projectId)
validationRules: Remove all special characters including hyphens from input
Validate against pattern for each segment
Reconstruct with single hyphens between segments
notes.collisionHandling: Reject if lowercase(new_name) exists in index (any case)
notes.caseHandling: Lowercase wins; warn user if name exists in different case
